verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is that 1Password CLI integrates with the 1Password app and signs in with Touch ID, Windows Hello, or another system authentication option. That suggests biometric unlock exists in the desktop ecosystem, but it does not show the mobile app locking itself behind biometrics or a PIN. Missing for 10: documentation of mobile app lock via Face ID, fingerprint, or PIN; auto-lock or timeout behavior that protects codes on a borrowed phone; and independent or hands-on corroboration.
